mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (amphetamine prodrug) causes dopamine release while haloperidol blocks dopamine receptors, creating direct pharmacodynamic antagonism and increasing risk of extrapyramidal side effects and reduced efficacy of both agents.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses, monitor closely for extrapyramidal symptoms and reduced stimulant efficacy, and consider alternative antipsychotics with less dopamine antagonism.
